expected.notes: §2.19 — total <$2000 is below many capitalization thresholds, but the item IS a durable complete unit with a 5-year useful life and serial number. Either capital (1506/1540 under tenant policy) or operating supplies (6025) is acceptable depending on the tenant's capitalization threshold. Price alone must not force operating.
